subject: Creativity
title: Blue Ocean Strategy: Competing by Not Competing
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Blue Ocean Strategy: Competing by Not Competing.

hook.text: Cirque du Soleil didn't compete with circuses. It cut animals, stars, and three rings — then charged more.

buildup.text: Red oceans are existing markets full of competition — bloody with rivals.

discovery.text: Blue ocean strategy cuts costly industry factors while raising and creating new value that customers actually want.

twist.text: Nintendo's Wii didn't compete on graphics. It competed on fun — creating a blue ocean by targeting non-gamers.

climax.text: Wii outsold PS3 and Xbox 360 despite having far inferior hardware.

punchline.text: The best way to beat the competition is to make the competition irrelevant.

quiz.question: What did Cirque du Soleil eliminate from the traditional circus model?
options: Animals, star performers, and three rings
